tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rta gzungs kyi cho ga cang shes char 'beb ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo badzra kro ta hya grī wa ya/ bcom ldan rta mchog dbang gi rgyal po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' cang shes nyi ma'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rta mgrin gyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs du ma nas 'byung ba dang*/ mgon po ber gyi gzhung nas dpal rab 'chang ba gsungs pa dang*/ rta gzungs rigs mi gcig pa nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam mthong ba'i don bsdus te/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gzhung man ngag dang bstun te/ rta lha'i cho ga rgyas par dgod pa ni/ bcas rnams man ngag zin bris yig chung ltar byas la/ gtor ma yi dam spyi gtor rta mgrin la bsngo/ rin chen 'bar ba che ba gcig la chung ba brgyad kyis bskor ba rta lha la bsngo/ zan la rta yi gzugs byas nas rta la drud pa'i changs bu de dang rta'i spu glud dang bcas pa rta glud bsngos la phyir dor ro// zan gtsang ma la liṅga byas la rta 'dre 'gugs gzhug byas la bsgral nas sgo'am lam gyi dkyil du dong cung zad brus nas mnan/ de 'dra tshar ci mang byas la/ rngog chags bsrung bya dmigs yul 'di thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi 'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs= dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs= 'phags pa rta mgrin rgyal po la skyabs= byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying po mi lus rta'i dbu la skyabs= 'phags pa khro bo re manta la skyabs= byang chub sems dpa' rnam thos sras la skyabs= dpal mgon po nag po rta yi lha la skyabs= gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po khams gsum dbang sgyur ba gang ba bzang po dang rta bdag ku be ra la sogs pa'i rta lha thams cad la skyabs su mchi 'o// bsrung bya rngog chags 'di rnams kyis thog drangs sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig

/sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma gnod byed bsnol ba'i gdan la rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po las rdo rje dmar po rtse dgu pa hrīḥyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi mthu stobs byin rlabs tshur bsdus hrīḥl thim/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa rta mgrin sku mdog dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ zhal rab tu khros pa'i dbu skra dmar ser 'bar ba'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher bas rta 'dre gnod byed brgyal bar byed pa/ spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur bsgrad pas gnod byed skrag cing sngangs bar byed pa/ zhal gdangs shing 'bar ba'i mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing 'jigs pa'i gad mo ha ha hi hi'i sgras khams gsum g.yo bar byed pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa nam mkhar gsor zhing*/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong nas 'gying ba/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal stag lpags kyi sham thabs glang ko'i stod g.yogs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug sbrul gyis brgyan pa'o// de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde chen dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hya grī wa badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal// rta skad drag po bsgrags pa yis// gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/

khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med par gyur/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'od dpag med pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rta dbu'i rtse mor 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan cing dbang lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥyig dmar po'i nang du bsrung bya rta rnams tshud nas yod pa'i hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng bye ru'i phreng ba lta bu rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar bsam/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro ta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsnyen pa ci nus bzla/ de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rang nyid rta mgrin gyis rta skad lan gcig bton pas rta la gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par sbur ma rlung gis ded pa ltar sngangs yed yed rang gi mdun du 'dus/ rta skad lan gnyis pa bton pas dam la btags nas phyin chad gnod pa mi byed par khas blangs dam bcas/ rta skad lan gsum pa bton pas da rung gdug sems 'chang ba rnams bya spu rlung gis khyer ba ltar rgya mtsho chen po'i phar 'gram du bskrad/ de nas rang gi sku las me dpung 'tshub cing 'bar bas rta la gnod byed thams cad bsregs nas me'i gur khang kha dog lnga ldan g.yas phyogs su 'khyil nas 'bar bar gyur/ de nas rang gi sku las 'phros pa'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs rtse phyir bstan pa'i gur/ de'i nang du dbyug to'i gur/ de'i nang du ral gri'i gur/ de'i nang du 'khor lo kha sbyor ba gnam lcags las grub pa/ rtsibs bye ba 'bum sde rno ngar dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i gur/

de'i nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba gur bla re/ de'i nang du rta mgrin dmar po ral gri dang sdigs mdzub can zhal phyir gyu nas zlog pa'i las mdzad pa'i gur/ de'i nang du rta mgrin dmar po rdo rje dang zhags pa can zhal nang du gyu nas srung ba'i gur/ de'i nang du rang gi g.yas g.yon dang mdun rnams su gser gyi sa gzhi dang*/ g.yu'i ne'u seng la sman gyi ljang bu 'khrungs pa la bsrung bya'i rta rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon dang sngags phreng las 'od zer dkar po shi sos kyi bdud rtsi lta bur 'phros/ rta rnams la phog pas rta'i nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad sang sang dag /'od zer ser po 'phros pas rta rnams 'phel zhing rgyas/ 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas 'byung ba'i bcud dang tshe bsod bsdus nas rta rnams la thim pas bkrag mdangs gze mgyogs rtsal shugs dang ldan/ 'od zer dmar nag me dpung gi rnam par 'phros/ rta la gnod pa'i nad gdon thams cad bya sgro me la bsreg pa ltar tshar bcad par gyur/ 'phags pa rta mgrin rgyal po yis// rkang bzhi rta rnams bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa rta lha'i rgyal po yis// rta rnams kun la srung du gsol// oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta bhandha hya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padmānta kṛta hya grī wa hrīḥbadzra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ rta rnams la srungs shig rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra kro ta hya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra kro ta hya grī wa ma hā kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ padmānta kṛta hya grī wa badzra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ padmānta kṛta badzra kro ta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ rta 'di rnams la srung du gsol/ bskyab tu gsol/ thugs rje'i dbang gis mnga' mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badzra kro ta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ārya kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/

'phags pa gzhon nu re mantas rta 'di rnams la srung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun tsam bzla/ de nas thun mtshams su gtor ma bran la/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// āḥlas bhandha dum gcig yangs pa'i nang*// gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// zhu zhing khol bas zag med bdud rtsir gyur// rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// 'phags pa rta mgrin rgyal po spyan drangs nas// mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ljags kyi rtse// 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur// oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ i dam baṃ linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hya grī wa arghaṃ sogs/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku padma'i gsung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje'i chos// spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas rngam chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'bul ba 'di bzhes la// rta la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs kun// skad cig tsam gyis thal ba rdul du rlogs// gnod byed dgra rkun thams cad zlog tu gsol// rta nad sdom dang rngo 'bras 'tsher nad dang*// 'khrugs chen tsha long grang long srin 'gag dang*// rnag nad skrangs 'bur glo nad 'theng grum dang*// gcong nad la gar mtshul bcu la sogs pa'i// rta nad thams cad zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod// rta drel rngog chags srung zhing skyob pa dang*// rngog chags tshe srog brtan par mdzad du gsol// de nas glud bsdus pa ni/ zan la rta gzugs byas changs bus bskor ba bran la 'di skad do// oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las ha yig yongs gyur las// rta glud rta mchog rab mdzes sga srab can// 'tsher skad lhang lhang 'dur 'gros chems se chem// gcig las brgya stong khri 'bum du ma 'phro// glud kyi changs bu 'dod yon longs spyod ldan// bgegs dang lan chags snang srid lha 'dre rnams// rab tu mgu zhing tshims pa nyid du gyur// hūm̐/

rta drel rngog chags kun la gnod pa yi// bgegs dang lan chags 'byung po btsan sri dang*// za re 'thung snyam byed pa'i lha srin rnams// byams pa'i sems kyis thams cad 'dir 'dus shig /badzra ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ bder gshegs rin chen mang dang gzugs mdzes dang*// 'byams klas 'jigs kun bral la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi changs bu dang*// 'bru sna phye mar bdud rtsi'i chab kyis sbrus// rta drel rngog chags gzugs brnyan 'bur du dod// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// rta mchog khri 'bum g.yu drel brgya dang stong*// gser sga g.yu mthur mu men gong smed bcas// 'dur 'gros chems chem lha 'dre'i spyan lam mdzes// 'tsher skad lhang lhang 'byung po'i rna bar snyan/ kha rlangs bun bun bgegs rigs sna la zhim// glud kyi changs bus lan chags bkres skom zhi// spu glud mdzes 'jam lha 'dre'i sku lus tshim// chu gtsang bran pas yi dwags bkres skom zhi// 'di 'dra'i rta glud ya mtshan ldan pa 'di// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rnams la sbyin// gdon rigs nyi khri chig stong rnams la bsngo// rta 'dre rtil sri bsen mo rnams la sbyin// tshe rabs sngon gyi lan chags rnams la bsngo// btsan 'dre yul 'dre sgab 'dre rnams la bsngo// dam sri god 'dre gri bo rnams la bsngo// thams cad ma lus ngoms shing tshims gyur cig /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam bhā ra sam bhā ra hūm̐/ gsum mam bdun bzla/ arghaṃ sogs/ hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang lan chags 'byung po'i tshogs// phywa dang g.yang la rku ba'i bse rag dang*// rta drel nor la gnod pa'i god 'dre dang*// rta phyugs srid sgab gcod pa'i god 'dre rnams// glud dang changs bu 'di yis mgu byos la// phyin chad gnod 'tshe gdug sems ma 'chang zhig /rang gi lus la gnod pa'i dpe longs la// nam yang phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig

/hūm̐/ bslu med dkon mchog gsum dang rta mchog dpal// rdo rje re manta yi bden pa'i mthus// rta drel rngog chags la gnod bgegs kyi tshogs// 'di ru ma 'dug myur bar gzhan du dengs// gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' gyur na// dpal chen khro rgyal rta mchog thugs khros nas// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gdon mi za// de bas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /oṃ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu gnod byed rta 'dre rta sri thams cad u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rol mo dang thun gyis brab/ gu gul bdug /de nas rta lha'i gtor ma bran la/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du g.yu'i ne'u seng gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/ ta la'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus su bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang brtsegs rin po che'i drwa ba drwa phyed g.yer ka dar 'phan gyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i steng du ha las rta mchog rma bya'i mgrin pa ltar sngo zhing chu ris dang ldan pa/ nywa bzhi nag po rlung gi shugs dang ldan pa dar za 'og gi stan dang gser sga g.yu mthur can/ mchong gi gong smed dang gser zhub dang ldan pa'i sga gong du hūm̐ yig dmar ser las 'od 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi gter bdag thams cad kyi nus pa bsdus hūm̐ la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las dpal 'phags pa rdo rje re manta sku mdog dmar ser 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig khro la 'dzum pa/ dbu la dngul gyi lcog zhu la bya phod dkar po dang dar gyis brgyan pa gsol ba/ sku la dar dmar ljang gi ber dang bse khrab ser po zhu lugs su mnabs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le rin chen sna tshogs skyugs pa bsnams pa/ gru mo g.yon na mdung dar ba dan dmar po can 'phyar ba/

zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis rta mchog gi steng na 'gying ba/ de'i spyi gtsug tu bya khyung gcig lding ba/ phrag gong na lcags kyi bya khra gnyis 'jum pa/ rgya stag dmar po gnyis mdun nas 'gro nas rta drel srung ba/ dung gi seng ge rgyab nas 'gying zhing ral pa sprug pa/ sngon po sgab ser rol du khrid pa 'o// de'i shar du hūm̐ yig dkar po las byung ba'i dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig spyan gsum khro zhing bzhad pa/ dbu skra'i thor tshugs la rin po che'i rtse bran lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas shel gyi 'khor lo dang g.yon pa rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ dar dkar po'i na bza'i steng du dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol zhing g.yu 'brug sngon po la 'chib pa/ mdun na lcags kyi bya khra lding zhing phyi na stag gzig mang po 'gro ba'o// lhor hūm̐ yig ser po las byung ba'i ārya re manta gser btso ma'i mdog can dar ser gyi ber dang gser gyi khrab mi zhub rta zhub gsol ba/ phyag g.yas shel gyi ral gri phyar ba las rin po che shel gyi char 'beb pa/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa nas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa/ sngon po chu ris nywa bzhi nag po'i steng na rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de'i nub tu hūm̐ yig dmar po la gzhon nu re manta sku mdog bye ru lta bu sgeg cing mdzes pa/ dbu la bse rmog dmar po dang sku la bse khrab dmar ser gsol ba/ phyag g.yas mda' dar dmar po bsnams pas rta g.yang sdud cing g.yon pas bse sgrom smug po bsnams pa/ rta rnams spel bar mdzad pa/ sngon po chu ris la 'chib pa'o// de'i byang du hūm̐ yig dmar nag las khro bo chen po re manta sku mdog dmar nag khrag gi mdog can zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum rab tu bsgrad cing ljags brkyang ba/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser 'bar ba/

rdo rje'i bse khrab dang bse rmog mnabs pa/ 'khor gsum rked la bskor zhing gru mo na mdung dar 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yas kyis bya khra 'gyed cing g.yon lcags kyi mda' gzhu bsnams pa/ cang shes sngo nag mtshal nag rting dkar rlung gi gshog can 'chib pa'o// shar lho mtshams su pāṃ yig las byung ba'i gang ba bzang po bse khrab dang bse rmog can/ phyag g.yas dpal dang 'byor pas gang ba'i bum pa dang*/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le bsnams shing sngon po chu ris la zhon pa'o// lho nub tu bai las byung ba'i rnam thos sras ser po rin po che'i prog zhu dang bse khrab gsol zhing seng ge la 'chib pa/ rin po che'i dbyug to dang ne'u le bsnams pa'o// nub byang du hūm̐ las mgon po nag po rta'i lha sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang mdung dar nag po 'phyar bas rta la gnod byed thams cad zlog par byed pa/ g.yon bum pa dang zhags pas gnod byed 'ching zhing rta nag po rting dkar la 'chibs nas gling bzhi yud tsam gyis bskor nas nyi zla skar chen gyi 'od 'phro ba'o// byang shar du ku las ku be ra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis khros shing am gtsigs bsdams pa/ sku la bse khrab dang dbu la bse rmog gsol ba/ phyag g.yas ral gri bsam gcod 'bar ba phyar bas rta la gnod byed thams cad tshar gcod cing*/ g.yon pas bsrung bya'i rta rnams kyi srab mda' la bzung nas rdzi bo mdzad pa/ chibs su rta nag po rlung gshog la zhon pa'o// de rnams kyi phyi rol du rta lha sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs gnod sbyin re manta sku la gser gyi khrab mi zhub rta zhub gsol ba/ dbu la lcog zhu dkar po bya phod kyis brgyan pa/ rta sngon po chu ris la 'chibs nas mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing 'dzam gling khyab par rgyug pa lnga brgyas bskor ba'o// de'i phyi rol du rta lha ku be ra la sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs 'bum sdes bskor ba'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/
mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing sngon/ thugs ka'i dbus su rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/

spos shug dud pa gtang rnga rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ sum rtsen lcang lo can dang dgung sngon dbus// rang bzhin gar bzhugs gnas mchog dam pa nas// rdo rje khro bo ārya re manta// rlung ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis gshegs su gsol// lha gnas dga' ba'i tshal dang 'dres ma'i tshal// tshal chen bzhi dang nyi ma shar phyogs nas// lha rnams yongs kyi so pa spyan rnon po// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po gshegs su gsol// ri rab chen po ri yi rtse mo na// chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa chen po nas// lha yi sras po 'phags pa re manta// thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'od stong 'bar ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nas// rlung rta bdun gyi mnga' bdag rdzu 'phrul can// nyi ma'i sras po gzhon nu re manta// mchod cing sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// lha dmag 'bum gyi lam mkhan lam gyi lha// rkang bzhi rngog chags kun gyi bdag po ste// rta sri sgrol mdzad khro bo re manta// lam lha chen po gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// lcang lo can dang yar 'brog ha bo'i gangs// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dam pa nas// srid gsum bdag po gnod sbyin gang ba bzang*// dpal dang 'byor pa spel phyir gshegs su gsol// ri rab byang phyogs gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse// rin chen pho brang bdun brtsegs mdzes pa dang*// byang phyogs ri mtho sa gtsang thams cad nas// sems dpa' rnam mang thos sras gshegs su gsol// byang shar rtsub 'gyur tshal dang bsil ba'i tshal// gdong dmar brag dang rin chen chos brag nas// rta yi srung ma ma hā kā la che// dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// byang phyogs 'jig rten gnod sbyin pho brang dang*// gling bzhi mun sel zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// zla ba'i sras po rta bdag ku be ra// rta rnams bsrung phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// nor lha chen po'i bka' nyan srung ma'i tshogs// sprul pa'i rta lha lnga brgya gnod sbyin 'bum// nor lha bye ba sa ya 'bum dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ ārya re manta sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ

hūm̐/ rin chen sa gzhi g.yu yi ne'u sing bkram// gser gyi bye ma bdud rtsi'i rdzing bus gtam// ta la'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus// rin chen khang brtsegs gser gyi drwa bas spras// dar gyi lda ldi g.yer kha mang pos brgyan// de dbus sna tshogs padma zla ba'i steng*// rlung gi shugs can cang shes sngon po'i khri// gtso dang 'khor du 'tsham pa'i gdan khri la// 'phags pa rdo rje khro bo re manta// 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes shing bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ārya re manta sa pa ri wā ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ hūm̐/ nyi ma shar ro dpal shar ro// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po ste// lam gyi rgyal po bde mdzad pa// dgra bla'i mchog ste nyi ma'i sras// gzi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba nyam thag don slad du// thugs rje'i dbang gis mgon mdzad pa// lam gyi dgra dang 'jigs pa sel/ khyu mchog rta rnams spel mdzad pa// mnga' mdzad thub dbang lha yi lha// thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal gzhon nu re manta// bdag gis dus rnams thams cad du// lha mchog khyod la dad pa yis// gus pa'i sems kyis phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ārya re manta a ti pū hoḥ pra ti tsa hoḥ hūm̐/ khro bo gzhon nu re manta// sprul pa'i 'khor dang yang g.yog bcas// gnod sbyin rnam sras gang ba bzang*// ma hā kā la ku be ra/ khyed rnams sngon gyi dam tshig can// bcom ldan shākya thub pa dang*// rta mgrin gsang bdag pad 'byung gi /spyan sngar rang srog snying po phul// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// rngog chags rta drel srung ba dang*// spel zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir// rang rang gzungs sngags phul ba yi// dam tshig gnyan po dgyes dgongs la// bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las ni// ma thogs myur du grub par mdzod// oṃ ārya re manta sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/

lce la bdud rtsi byin par bsam la/ bum chu'i bdud rtsi gtor/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi dngos// dgos 'dod kun 'byung rin chen cod pan mchog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dbang bskur bla na med// gter bdag gnod sbyin rnams la 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ ratna mu ku ṭaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes cod pan gyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur ro// oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā ba= stong pa'i ngang las rin chen snod nang du// nyer spyod 'dod yon rin chen 'bru sman dang*// rten rdzas skong rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas// rgya chen zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod// zag med bde ba skyed pa nyid du gyur// oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ hūm̐/ 'phags mchog rdo rje khro bo re manta// rigs bzhi'i 'khor dang khro bo rang 'dra bcas// gang bzang rnam sras mgon po ku be ra// yang 'khor nor lha bye ba'i tshogs bcas la// yan lag brgyad ldan chab dang bsil ba'i chu// 'dab brgyad kha dog mdzes pa padma'i tshogs// spos dkar a ga ru dang tsandan dang*// 'bru mar rtsi mar rin chen nor bu'i 'od// bzang shing dri zhim ngad ldan gtsang ma'i chab// ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas sna tshogs dang*// rnga dang dril bu sil snyan rol mo'i dbyangs// sku gzugs cang shes sngo bkra mdzes pa'i gzugs// bstod dbyangs gzungs kyi 'dzab dbyangs snyan pa'i sgra// bzang shing zas sna spos dkar bsregs pa'i dri// dkar gsum mngar gsum zas phud tshogs pa'i ro// sna tshogs dar zab stag ras gzig ras dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa rgya mtsho 'bul// gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag 'bul ba ni// dmigs rten ris su bris dang 'bur du gtod// dpag med dngos 'dra nam mkha' gang bar spros// 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo glang po mchog /rta mchog dmag dpon blon po rin po che// gdugs dang dung dkar gser nya pad ma mchog

/bum pa dpal be 'khor lo rgyal mtshan dang*// me long li khri dung dang gi wang dang*// dūr ba zho dang bil ba ku sha dang*// yo byad phun sum tshogs pa rgya mtsho 'bul// sman lnga dri lnga 'bru lnga snying po lnga// rin chen lnga dang dar tshon sna lnga dang*// mda' dang mdung dang bse khrab rmog zhu dang*// dar ber ljang bkra cang shes chu ris sogs// mthun rdzas rnam pa du ma 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ ārya re manta sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur pa la/ rta lha rnams kyi ljags las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gsol bar gyur/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sogs/ oṃ badzra kro ta re manta i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ buddha kro ta re manta i daṃ= oṃ ārya re manta i daṃ= oṃ ku ma rā re manta i daṃ= oṃ ma hā kro ta re manta i daṃ= oṃ pūrṇa bha dra ya i daṃ= oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya i daṃ= oṃ ma hā kā la gho ra de wa i daṃ= oṃ ku be ra ya i dam= oṃ sarba yaksha gho ra dhe wa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ dpal rdo rje khro bo chen po re manta sku gsung thugs 'khor dang bcas pa/ dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po/ lam lha chen po 'phags pa re manta/ nyi ma'i sras po gzhon nu re manta/ khro bo chen po rta lha re manta/ dpal 'byor gang ba bzang po/ rdo rje gnod sbyin rnam thos sras/ rta lha mgon po nag po/ rta bdag ku be ra la sogs pa rta lha 'khor sprul pa yang sprul g.yog dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du 'bul lo// sku gsung thugs mnyes shing tshims nas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/

khyad par du bdag gi rta rnams bsrung zhing bskyab pa dang*/ sdom lhad grang ba 'theng grum la sogs pa'i rta nad thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang*/ lam gyi dgra dang glo bur gyi dgra rkun thams cad zlog pa dang*/ bdag gi rta drel rngog chags thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ tshe bsod brtan pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /hūm̐/ 'phags mchog byang chub sems dpa' re manta// 'gro ba rkang 'khyams ngal ba skyob pa'i phyir// rta lhar sprul nas rngog chags 'phel mdzad pa// rdo rje re manta la phyag 'tshal bstod// sum rtsen chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa na// lha min gdug pa'i bar chad bsal ba'i phyir// so dang bya ra mdzad pa lha yi dpal// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po khyod la bstod// thub dbang drung du rang srog gzungs sngags phul// 'gro ba'i phongs pa sel bar dam bcas pa'i// nor lha chen po ārya re manta// rngog chags spel mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// gling bzhi'i mun pa ma lus sel ba'i phyir// rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta bdun rab skyod pa// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la sprin bzhin du// gzhon nu re manta la phyag 'tshal bstod// lha chen nyi ma'i sras su sku 'khrungs shing*// dgung sngon dbus nas gling bzhi khyab par rgyug /nyi ma'i gzhal yas rlung rta bdun gyi bdag /nyi ma'i sras po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngon tshe lha dang lha min 'thabs pa'i tshe// lha dmag bye ba 'bum gyi lam mkhan mdzad/ khyod sngags dran pas lam gyi 'jigs pa sel// lam lha chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i bstan dang rngog chags rta rnams la// gnod pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po lam gyi dgra// rdul du brlag phyir rab khros gtum po'i sku/ khro bo re manta la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dam pa nas/ khams gsum dbang sgyur dpal dang 'byor pa'i dpal// thugs dam srog snying dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// gnod sbyin gang ba bzang por phyag 'tshal bstod// byang chub sems dpa' gser 'dra seng ge zhon// mi 'jigs skyob phyir rin chen dbyug to 'dzin// nor rnams spel phyir phyag g.yon ne'u le 'dzin// rta nor spel mdzad rnam thos sras la bstod// rnal 'byor dgra bla dug gsum nad kyi sman// rig 'dzin srog shing lha yi sde dpon mchog

/rta lha mgon po rta nag rting dkar 'chib// nyi zla skar chen 'od zer 'phro la bstod// gnod sbyin sde dpon rta bdag ku be ra// mthing nag ral gri 'bar bas gnod byed sdigs// phyag g.yon srab mda' 'dzin pas rdzi bo mdzad// rta yi srung ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sprul pa'i rta lha ārya re manta// lnga brgya'i grangs ldan rta sngon gser zhub can// yang 'khor gnod sbyin nor lha bye ba 'bum// ma lus 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do// zhes bstod/ rang nyid rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros/ mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs kar rang sngags kyis bskor ba la phog /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du rang la thim pa dang*/ 'od zer bsrung bya'i rta rnams la phog /rta nad thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa ltar sang sang dag cing bsal/ rta rnams tshe srog rab tu brtan pa dang 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro ta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ārya kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'phags pa gzhon nu re mantas rta rnams srung du gsol/ zhes bzla ba ni bdag mdun gnyis sbrags la bsgrub pa'o// rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sna tshogs byung*/ rdo rje re manta'i zhal du mchod pa'i tshul du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ lte ba nas rang gi snying gar thim pas dngos grub thams cad thob par gyur/ oṃ badzra kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badzra kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badzra re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul/

'od zer dkar po zla ba'i 'od zer lta bu 'phros/ rta rnams la phog pas rta nad thams cad sangs dag par gyur/ oṃ buddha kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ ha de phu ni ha de phu ni ha swā hā/ tadya thā/ shrī ma thi ra ma thi ra ma thi ra bhya phaṭa/ phu ta pa ra ma ti ni/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ u su ri ti swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya ha de phu ni u ti swā hā/ rang gi thugs nas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ ārya re manta'i thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer gser btso ma lta bu byung nas rang gi rta dang gnas khang thams cad la khyab pas rta drel rngog chags thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ na mo ratna tra yā ya ha de phu ni ha de phu ni phu phu swā hā/ tadya thā/ thi ri thi ri pra dzñā ba ra ti ni/ da ra da ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ u yu ti ni swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ ma wer na dhe wa a su u pa ni swā hā/ ārya re manta swā hā/ oṃ ārya re manta kro dha rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā/ ārya re manta he he phu ka swā hā/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer glog zhags lta bu 'phros/ gzhon nu re manta'i thugs rgyud bskul bas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros/ 'jig rten khams thams cad kyi rta drel rngog chags thams cad kyi g.yang dang dngos grub bsdus nas rang dang bsrung bya la thim par gyur/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo sa dong ka rā tsa/ bhya ha ba na de bhū ne swā hā/ na mo de ba pu tra pra ha he pu bhi dhi dhe he de bhu ni ha re pu ni de swā hā/ oṃ tadya thā/ shrī ye shrī ye ma nu/ pra dzñā ba ra te na tsa ra/ tsa ra i baṃ ta ni dhi ri dhi ri bhu dha ni swā hā/ oṃ ārya re manta bdag gi dbang du gho ra sarba pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ ha de phu ni ha de phu ni swā hā/ tadya thā/ gri ni ye shrī ye purṇi dzi pa ra/

ta ra ni dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri u u ti ni swā hā/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag 'phros/ khro bo re manta la phog pas dbu gtsug dang phrag pa'i khyung dang lcags kyi bya khra las khyung dang bya khra'i tshogs spros pas nam mkha' bar snang gang*/ mdun rgyab kyi stag seng las stag dang seng ge'i tshogs spros pas sa gzhi khyab ste/ rta la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad la bya khra dang khyung gi tshogs 'jum zhing klad pa bton/ stag dang seng ges zos/ gdon dang gdug pa thams cad bya khyung gi tshogs kyis ded nas bskrad pas mtshams bcad par gyur/ oṃ ma hā kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gang ba bzang po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer ser po 'phros shing rta rnams la thim pas/ rta rnams bsrung zhing spel ba dang*/ rta'i dpal g.yang thams cad spel bar gyur/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mast+rai ya dhi lokya bha ha ra bhi tri ta pa ya da na/ rta 'di rnams la srungs shig /nor rnams spel cig swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma st+rai lokya ghu ti bhu ra ti te ya na/ rta rnams la srungs shig /nor rnams spel cig swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma st+rai lo ki li ti bhi ri bhi ri ha sa ma na ye swā hā/ rta rnams srung du gsol/ rta rnams spel cig swā hā/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma st+rai lokya bha ra bha ra/ bhi ti bhi ti sa man dha/ rta 'di rnams la srungs shig /nor rnams spel cig /oṃ pūrṇa bha dra gho ra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer rnam sras la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer ser po'i sna las rin po che'i char 'bebs shing spel ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā badzra rakṣa/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā sa ma ya rta rnams srungs shig /nor rnams spel cig swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā badzra bdag gi rta rnams la srungs shig swā hā/

bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer rta lha mgon po nag po la phog pas mgon po nag pos rta rnams srung zhing*/ rta la gnod pa thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las la brtson par gyur/ oṃ ma hā kā la ru ru sha te ga te ni swā hā/ tadya thā/ hi li hi li ki ti ni tsi ti ni swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la dhu na dhu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya ga ni na sha ya hi ka gi na/ tadya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li ga ta ni tsi swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya dha ru sha na swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ka la ga ne sha ya ta ghri na ta/ oṃ ma hā kā la du du sha pa te ga te ni swā hā/ tadya thā/ oṃ hi li hi li/ ki ti ni tsi te na swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ne sha ya ta ghi ni/ tadya thā/ oṃ a ka he ni hi la swā hā/ rta'i nad dang gnod pa thams cad mgon po nag pos thul cig /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ ku be ra'i thugs rgyud bskul pas rang 'dra ba'i ku be ra 'bum phrag 'phros te phyag g.yas ral gri phyar nas rta la gnod pa thams cad bsad bcad gtubs nas med par byed cing*/ g.yon gyi phyag gis rta'i srab mda' bzung nas rta'i rdzi bo byed par gyur/ oṃ ku be ra ye ra ye swā hā/ oṃ ku be ra swā hā/ gho ra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ srungs shig /

ces mang nyung ci rigs pa bzla/ de nas nyams chag bskang phyir skong bshags bya ste/ hūm̐/ bhrūm̐ las skong rdzas ri rab bang rim bzhi// shar phyogs shel la lho phyogs bai ḍūrya// nub phyogs rā ga byang phyogs gser las grub// gling bzhi ri rab lcags ri khor yug bcas// bya gcan ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas tshogs// lha mi'i longs spyod 'dod yon dpag med bcas// nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis mngon sprul nas// rta lha 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed byed 'dis// rdo rje re manta yi thugs dam bskang*// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// ārya re manta yi thugs= gzhon nu re manta yi thugs= khro bo re manta yi thugs= rtsa gsum lha tshogs so so'i thugs= lam lha dgra bla chen po'i thugs= gzi ldan nyi ma'i sras po'i thugs= rlung rta bdun gyi bdag po'i thugs= sar gnas 'phags pa chen po'i thugs= rngog chags yongs kyi bdag po'i thugs= dpal 'byor gang ba bzang po'i thugs= rdo rje rnam thos sras kyi thugs= rta lha mgon po nag po'i thugs= rta bdag ku be ra yi thugs= sprul pa rta lha lnga brgya'i thugs= yang 'khor lha dmag bye ba'i thugs= hūm̐/ yang cig ārya re man 'khor bcas kyi// thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni// bris sku 'bur sku rta sngon rgyan ldan dang*// g.yag lug bya rta'i gzugs 'gros sna tshogs kyis/ khyed kyi sku yi thugs dam bskang gyur cig /lung tang phreng ba dkar gsum gtor ma dang*// rnga dang rol mo bstod dbyangs sna tshogs dang*// srog snying gser dngul mtshal gyis bris pa 'dis/ khyed kyi gsung gi thugs dam bskang gyur cig /rin chen 'bar ba bris dang 'bur du btod// srog gi 'khor lo rta sngon snying dang mig /gser dngul skra bzang la sogs rin chen lngas/ khyod kyi thugs kyi thugs dam bskang gyur cig /mda' mo bya rgod dar tshon sna lngas brgyan// stag ras gzig ras bse khrab bse yi rmog

/'jol ber ljang bkra mdung dar ba dan can/ khyed kyi yon tan thugs dam bskang gyur cig /lcags kyi bya khra lcags mda' lcags gzhu dang*// ral gri 'bar ba rta nag rting dkar sogs// gnad nas bskul zhing phrin las bsgrub pa yis/ khyed kyi phrin las thugs dam bskang gyur cig /hūm̐/ khro bo chen po ārya re manta// rngog chags srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs// sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan las ma 'da' bar// 'bod pa'i dus na rta lha snyan ma sra// g.yab pa'i tshe na rta lha spyan ma rtul// rbad pa'i tshe na rta lha mthu ma chung*// mngag pa'i tshe na rta lha bang ma bul// sngar byas las kyi gtang rag gnyan po 'bul// phyi byed las kyi zhu skyems gnyan po 'bul// da lta las kyi gnyer zas 'di bzhes la// rta lha 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /hūm̐/ thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa re manta// gnod sbyin rta lha'i 'khor tshogs bcas pa rnams// rnal 'byor bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams ye shes spyan ldan dus gsum gzigs// bdag ni ma rig dbang gis gti mug pas// rten rdzas ma tshang mchod pa'i phud nyams dang*// ting 'dzin ma gsal bzlas brjod sngags ma dag /lhag bsam mi ldan rang 'dod khong du bcug /bsod nams mi ldan sbyin pa'i 'bras bu yal// chog shes chung zhing ha cang 'dod skyon sogs/ khyed rnams thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa// rab tu gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags// oṃ sa ma ya/ āḥs ma ya/ hūm̐ sa ma ya/ oṃ ārya re manta swā hā/ oṃ badzra satwa sogs yig brgya bzla/ hūm̐/ rdo rje khro bo chen po re manta// shar phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dpal rab 'chang*// lam lha'i rgyal po ārya re manta// nyi ma'i sras po gzhon nu re manta// rab 'jigs khro bo chen po re manta// gang ba bzang po rdo rje rnam thos sras// ma hā kā la rta bdag ku be ra/ khyed rnams 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas// rta drel gnod pa'i dgra bgegs zlog tu gsol// glo bur dgra rkun 'phrog pa zlog tu gsol// tsha long grang long srin 'gag zlog tu gsol// 'khrugs chen skrangs 'bur rnag nad zlog=

glo dang lheb dang 'theng grum zlog= rngo dang 'bras dang 'tsher long zlog= glo nad gcong grum mtshul bcu zlog= gza' nad zer ma gdon nad zlog= tshun lang khrag 'khrugs 'tsher gcu zlog= sdom rigs 'khrugs dang btsan sri zlog= 'phrang bdud dgung sngon bya zhon zlog= rtsa sdom stod 'khrugs smad slad zlog= chu sri rkang gnyis 'theng ba zlog= rtsa grum lag gnyis grum pa zlog= chag rigs gtsong dang la gar zlog= sa grib gnam grib chu grib zlog= sna nad 'khrug lang chu byi zlog= brgyal nad glo bur nad rnams zlog= rta yi lam gyi 'jigs pa zlog= 'tsher nad sri lang rims chag zlog= ltas ngan skar ma ngan pa zlog= lam 'dre lam dgra byes 'gong zlog tu gsol// rta la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs da thul cig /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// de nas rta 'dre rtil sri brub pa ni/ liṅga shog ling ngam zan ling brub khung ngam zangs lcags snod du bzhag /chang rgod dam khrag gis bran/ rang nyid rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal gyis/ stong pa'i ngang las brub khung gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du yi ge tri yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod byed god 'dre rtil sri mig shi mig /rkang pa lcags su bcug pa gcer bu 'dar phril li li byed par gyur/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam dpal chen rta mgrin gyi bden= khro bo chen po re manta 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden= dpal ma hā kā la gnod sbyin gyi tshogs dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus spyir zhing bcu tshang ba bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ khyad par du bdag dang bsrung bya'i rta drel rngog chags rnams kyi tshe la rku ba srog la 'jab ba'i god 'dre god sri/ rta 'dre rtil sri/ sgab 'dre sgab sri/ bse rag ltogs 'gong dbul sri gang yin pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga ming byang bu 'di la khug cig

/oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro ta hya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ārya kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnod byed badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥ hūm̐/ rdo rje khro bo re manta/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ khyod kyi spyi bo'i gtsug rum na/ khyung chen 'bar ba lding zhing 'bar// gcig las brgya 'phros brgya las stong*// sprul pa khyung gis nam mkha' gang*// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs// nam mkha'i mtha' la bros na yang*// rang dbang med par khug la shog /sder mo lcags kyus snying nas drongs// ral gri 'bar ba'i gshog pas gtubs// chu gri 'bar ba'i rkang pas gzir// rdo rje'i mchu yis glo snying drongs// dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod// rta la gnod byed bgegs rnams kun// skad cig tsam gyis thal bar rlogs// oṃ khroṃ ga ru ḍaḥganod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ khro bo chen po re manta/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ khyod kyi phrag gong g.yas g.yon na// lcags kyi bya khra lding zhing 'jum// gcig las brgya 'phros brgya las stong*// sprul pa'i bya khras bar snang gang*// sha log sdang mig chems se chem// gshog sgra 'brug ltar 'u ru ru// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs// byi'u ltar bros kyang khra ltar snyogs// rang dbang med par chums la shog /mchu sder rnon pos glo snying phyungs// rta la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// skad cig tsam gyis brlag par mdzod// oṃ ga ru ḍaḥganod byed mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ ārya kro ta re manta/ khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ khyod kyi mdun dang rgyab phyogs kyi// stag dang seng ge 'gro zhing 'gying*// gcig las brgya 'phros brgya las stong*// sprul pa'i bya khras bar snang gang*// stag dang seng ges sa gzhi gang*// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs// sha ltar bros kyang khyi ltar snyogs// rang dbang med par ded la shog

/ngar sgras dgra bgegs lha dang phrol/ kha rlangs gdug pas myos su chug /mchu sder rnon pos sha rus 'chos// rta la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs rnams// skad cig tsam gyis thal bar rlogs// oṃ badzra kro ta re manta gnod byed god 'dre thams cad ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces thun gyis brab bo// de nas phur pa thogs la 'di skad do// hūm̐/ rta mgrin rgyal po'i dus la bab// re manta yi dus la bab// dpal rab 'chang ba'i dus la bab// ku be ra yi dus la bab// mgon po nag po'i dus la bab// gnod sbyin sde dpon dus la bab// padma kro ta kī la ya// stod ni khro chen rta mgrin rgyal// 'chang gzung khro bo re manta// rgya mdud ma hā kā la ste// chu srin kha nas 'brug stong ldir// sbrul chun mtshams nas glog stong 'khyug /zur gsum rno ngar dbal dang ldan// phyar ba tsam gyis srid gsum sngangs// btab na lha yang brlag par byed// dgra dang bgegs la smros ci dgos// las ngan god 'dre rtil sri khyod// bsam ngan 'chang ba snying yin pas// snying dkar nag mtshams su kī la ya// smra zhing za ba kha yin pas// lce yi dkyil du kī la ya// blta bar byed pa mig yin pas// mig 'bras gnyis la kī la ya// bsnyab par byed pa lag pa yin// dpung pa gnyis la kī la ya// 'gro bar byed pa rkang yin pas// pus mo gnyis la kī la ya// stobs nus rten dang phral ba'i phyir// srog yig tri la kī la ya// gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ hrīḥbadzra kro ta hya ghri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ārya kro ta re manta ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra kī li kī la ya gnod byed god 'dre mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces phur pa btab nas ling ro de lam zhabs sam skas zhabs sam sgo them zhabs su mnan te/ de nas dang po dong brus la/ phaṭa/ rang nyid rta mgrin gyis phyag g.yas ral gri sa la brgyabs pas sa dum bu gnyis su bkas nas rgya mtsho sngo mer gyis song ba'i nang nas/
